etymologies.etymologyHTML: From attain +‎ -ment; compare Old French ataignement.

definitions.definition: The act of attaining; the act of arriving at or reaching; the act of obtaining by exertion or effort.
That which is attained, or obtained by exertion.

quote.text: The scholar who had made so many attainments, knows now how small they were compared with what one glance into the spiritual glory has taught him.
